title: FPP PTP lock requires valid management evidence
problem: A missing or malformed master_offset defaults to zero and falsely settles SLAVE; a failed TIME_STATUS_NP query also falsely settles LISTENING. This is a separate lock-validation defect found while investigating the software-PTP epoch issue.
reproduce: Compile the pinned upstream RefreshPtpCache and WaitForPtpLock methods with simulated pmc replies, including missing offset and failed query.
acceptance: Reject invalid or missing synchronization evidence, keep valid master and standalone behavior, and avoid signed overflow for INT64_MIN.
repair: Track offset and grandmaster-presence validity separately; require valid follower evidence and compare signed offset bounds directly.

verification.limitations: Extracted real cache and wait methods compiled under UBSan; pmc, process checks and logging are stubbed. No full FPP build, PTP traffic, GStreamer playback or physical audio qualification. Does not fix CLOCK_REALTIME discipline into 1970 or guarantee freshness of a valid linuxptp measurement.
verification.ownerCheck: Build patched FPP, verify normal master/follower startup and management-query failures. Keep issue #2848 open: collect NIC timestamping capability, PTP status and UTC date before designing and testing separate media/system clocks.
